keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! St. Louis City SC 1, LA Galaxy 0. Carlo Holse (St. Louis City SC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Rafael Navarro.
Goal! St. Louis City SC 2, LA Galaxy 0. Carlo Holse (St. Louis City SC) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Rafael Navarro with a through ball.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. João Klauss replaces Kyogo Furuhashi.
Goal! St. Louis City SC 3, LA Galaxy 0. Carlo Holse (St. Louis City SC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Chris Durkin with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Conrad Wallem (St. Louis City SC).
Delay in match because of an injury Julián Aude (LA Galaxy).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! St. Louis City SC 3, LA Galaxy 1. Robert Taylor (LA Galaxy) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Erik Thommy.
